name: France
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national level. Votes and bills of the Assemblée nationale (17th and 16th legislatures) and the Sénat (12 June 2025), the 16 Feb 2025 Le Monde appeal, the 7 Nobel economists' tribune, the main NGOs, unions and left parties, and four French signatories of Proud to Pay More. Register: 13 regions plus 5 overseas regions and 101 départements (INSEE codes); the 34,920 communes (INSEE, COG 2025) are loaded under their départements and mapped (metropolitan France; Etalab contours, Licence Ouverte 2.0); overseas communes are in the register but have no shape. Party column follows the parliamentary group or Wikidata, and is approximate for GDR, LIOT and non-attached members. Not done: Senate votes of Nov 2025, Dec 2024 NFP budget votes, PLF 2027 votes (Oct 2026), the full 2025 appeal list, MEP petition list, Meurthe-et-Moselle department motion (site blocked), media, Tondelier/Roussel/Piketty statements, other unions (FSU, Solidaires), regional and local sweep.

polls.question: 2% tax on wealth above EUR 100m (taxe Zucman)
2% tax on wealth above EUR 100m (taxe Zucman)

Whether the deputies were wrong to reject the 'taxe Zucman' (2% of wealth for households above EUR 100m, about 1,800 households, professional assets included); 59% said wrong to reject, 40% right to reject
